tasks.title: Build deterministic ARC task loader, exact scorer and leakage-safe development split
tasks.success_test: Repository can validate ARC grids, score pass@2 predictions exactly, deterministically partition public-training task IDs, and prove via tests that public-evaluation files are not required by the default development command path.

tasks.title: Implement authorized Gemma provider adapter, deterministic cache and smoke test
tasks.success_test: A GitHub Actions smoke workflow uses the repository GEMINI_API_KEY secret without exposing it, verifies the live provider model identifier, records request/usage metadata, and caches a non-benchmark test call through a provider-independent target-model interface.
tasks.progress: Historical path retained for reproducibility. Gemma is now a legacy comparator and should not receive routine research budget after the 2026-08-23 NVIDIA pivot.

tasks.title: Establish fixed Gemma 4 26B A4B baseline on the frozen development split
tasks.success_test: Historical objective only; no further routine execution.
tasks.progress: ARC-R013 established that increasing max_output_tokens from 2048 to 8192 only increased Gemma thought-token consumption while still producing no final candidate. The earlier 16k input-TPM issue was separately mitigated by pacing. Work stopped before a full Gemma baseline.
tasks.cancelled_reason: Operator-directed model/provider pivot on 2026-08-23. Gemma and GPT-OSS are legacy comparators; focus routine budget on NVIDIA-hosted DeepSeek V4 Flash and Nemotron 3 Ultra.

tasks.title: Promote NVIDIA NIM into the provider-neutral cached target-model path
tasks.success_test: Repository has a provider-neutral NVIDIA NIM adapter using NVIDIA_API_KEY only from environment/Actions secret, deterministic cache/accounting, tests, and live non-ARC smoke evidence for both deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 and nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b without exposing the secret.
tasks.progress: Pre-task operational probe already proved the repository NVIDIA_API_KEY works on the common NVIDIA endpoint for Nemotron 3 Ultra (HTTP 200, ~0.687 s) and DeepSeek V4 Flash (HTTP 200, ~0.667 s). GPT-OSS-120B and Gemma 4 31B timed out at 120 s and are not active targets. Evidence: lab/recon/nvidia-model-smoke-latest.json.

tasks.title: Select the stronger NVIDIA ARC research engine: DeepSeek V4 Flash vs Nemotron 3 Ultra
tasks.success_test: A small frozen public-training-derived development slice compares DeepSeek V4 Flash and Nemotron 3 Ultra under a controlled protocol and budget, recording exact solves, parseability, reasoning/output tokens, latency, failures, cache hits and known ARC-specific model exposure; one model is selected as the fixed primary engine by evidence rather than reputation.
tasks.blocker: Requires provider-neutral NVIDIA execution path and cached accounting first.

tasks.title: Establish the selected NVIDIA model baseline on the frozen development split
tasks.success_test: The tournament winner has a fully cached reproducible baseline on the frozen development split with exact task accuracy, attempts, model/protocol/settings, calls/tokens/runtime, per-task outputs and failure taxonomy without public-eval feedback.

tasks.title: Compare direct prompting against structured hypothesis-generation + exact verification
tasks.success_test: Matched ablation shows whether structured generate-test-reject search produces a statistically and qualitatively defensible held-out improvement over direct prompting at controlled target-model budget.
